patch_description:
This version strengthens the constructor using several layered hexagonal row patterns, asymmetric perturbations, repeated joint SLSQP optimization, LP radius polishing, and a fixed-radius center-clearance phase. The LP phase computes the globally best radii for each candidate center layout, while the clearance phase slightly deflates those radii and moves centers to release nearly-degenerate contacts before a final joint radius-and-center optimization.

All returned radii are finally scaled by a strict numerical safety margin, ensuring every circle remains inside the unit square and all pairs remain non-overlapping.
